heading: Choose Your <highlight>Tour</highlight> Package
subtitle: Handcrafted Bali & Nusa Penida itineraries designed to fit every budget and travel style.

items.title: 4D3N Package
items.agentTip: This package perfectly balances Ubud's peaceful culture and Nusa Penida's breathtaking beaches. It is highly popular for weekend travelers. We recommend packing a swimsuit, sunscreen, and sandals for Nusa Penida's wet boat landing.

includes.title: Hotel
includes.description: Hotel room for 2 (extra bed available). Staying at Bhanuswari Resort & Spa (Sukawati - Ubud area).

includes.title: Meals
includes.description: Meals included (3× breakfast, 2× lunch, 2× dinner). Sunset seafood dinner at Jimbaran.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Jimbaran Sunset

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Adventure
items: Early departure 06:30 AM to Sanur Port
Cross to Nusa Penida by fast boat
Kelingking Beach — iconic T-Rex cliff viewpoint
Return to harbour & cross back to Bali
itinerary.tip: Fast boat boarding at Sanur Port requires stepping directly into shallow seawater. Wear sandals and shorts/comfortable clothes!

itinerary.title: Ubud Cultural Tour
items: Lunch at Kintamani with Mount Batur volcano view
itinerary.tip: Bring a sarong or wear long pants/skirts for Tirta Empul temple. Local sarongs are also available for rent at the temple gate.

items.title: 5D4N Package
items.agentTip: Ideal for families and couples who want to experience Ubud and South Bali without rush. Includes strategic hotel switching between Ubud (greenery) and Jimbaran (coastline) to dodge Bali's main traffic congestion.

items: Early departure 06:30 AM to Sanur Port
Cross to Nusa Penida by fast boat
Kelingking Beach — iconic T-Rex cliff viewpoint
Return to harbour & cross back to Bali
itinerary.tip: Nusa Penida roads are narrow and winding. Our driver is highly experienced, but if you are prone to motion sickness, taking medication 30 minutes before arrival is highly recommended.

itinerary.title: Ubud Cultural Tour
items: Tukad Cepung Waterfall — hidden cave waterfall
Lunch at Kintamani with Mount Batur volcano view
Transport to Jimbaran Bay Beach Resort (South Bali)

itinerary.title: Uluwatu & South Coast
items: GWK Cultural Park — Garuda Wisnu Kencana statue
Uluwatu Temple — clifftop temple at sunset
itinerary.tip: Keep your sunglasses, hats, and shiny jewelry secure in your bag when walking around Uluwatu Temple, as the resident monkeys love to grab loose objects.

items.title: 6D5N Package
items.agentTip: Our ultimate signature package covering all 5 geographical zones of Bali. From UNESCO rice terraces to clifftop temples, this itinerary is packed with high-value photo spots. Make sure your phone and camera batteries are fully charged!

Cross to Nusa Penida by fast boat

Return to harbour & cross back to Bali
itinerary.tip: A waterproof bag is highly useful for the boat landing and Crystal Bay beach activities.

itinerary.title: Ubud & East Bali
items: Tukad Cepung Waterfall — hidden cave waterfall
Lunch at Kintamani with Mount Batur volcano view
Lempuyang Temple — Gates of Heaven with Mt. Agung view
itinerary.tip: Lempuyang Temple's 'Gate of Heaven' queue can get extremely long. We recommend departing Ubud at 5:00 AM sharp with our driver to get a priority queue ticket.

itinerary.title: Tanah Lot & Bedugul
items: Ulun Danu Beratan Temple — serene lake temple
Photo at the iconic Handara Gate
Jatiluwih Rice Terrace — UNESCO World Heritage
Tanah Lot Temple — iconic sea temple at sunset
Transport to Jimbaran Bay Beach Resort (South Bali)
itinerary.tip: Ulun Danu Beratan is situated in the high mountains, meaning it can be chilly and foggy. Bringing a light jacket/sweater is highly recommended.
